blend: One convex weight fit by paired Brier on selected specification August-March chronological OOF probability vectors; never use in-sample public predictions.

limitations: Cuts dependence at month boundaries; few blocks per month at 14 days.
Approximate finite-sample and model-selection inference, not a coverage theorem.
Does not represent unknown source revisions.
bootstrap.primary_family: Two horizon-specific trained-minus-public Brier contrasts; 97.5 percent marginal intervals provide approximate Bonferroni family coverage.
bootstrap.scheme: Uniform nonwrapping consecutive calendar blocks with replacement within each stratum, truncate sampled positions to original stratum length, retain original timestamps and integer date multiplicities. Include missing calendar positions; do not bridge gaps.
bootstrap.support: Validate minimum original eligible error-date support before resampling; replicas require positive eligible weight and finite fits, without a minimum unique resampled-date filter.

collection.availability_policy: NOAA object LastModified and nominal bulletin time plus 30 minutes must precede checkpoint; decoded reference time must also precede checkpoint. Market candle end must precede checkpoint. Historical per-market rules are assumed applicable to the archived event and are not claimed to be a contemporaneous rules snapshot.
limitations: One city; final development covers approximately ten months and holdout covers spring/early summer.
Archived availability and rules are reconstructed, not contemporaneous capture.
Candle midpoints do not establish executable quotes or fills.
NDFD daytime grid MaxT differs from the station full-day settlement target.
collection.scope_reason: Frozen replication input cohort. Reuse the immutable June-August 2025 panel and acquire September 2025-June 2026 in a separate bounded partition. Model and inference choices are specified by the enclosing historical_replication_v1 protocol.
collection.target_policy: Archived market rules must name Central Park and NWS Climatological Report (Daily). Use each market's expiration_value, reconcile all bin results, and compare against NCEI daily TMAX without excluding score cases based on agreement. Daily window uses EST local standard time; NDFD daytime MaxT is a predictor transformed through training residuals.

coverage_policy: Inventory all395 requested dates and both horizons; retain documented source/eligibility exclusions and compare all methods on identical retained cases. Verify Central Park/NWS rules for every requested event; never pool incompatible target definitions or choose replacement holdout dates from outcomes.

pre_outcome_amendment.reason: Role-wide blocks can omit early fit months; imposing original20distinct-error-date support on resampled multiplicities rejects many otherwise legitimate draws. Stratify by calendar month and separate point-sample support from replicate existence.

selection: Freeze each candidate at validation_fit_at for all January-March predictions; choose equal-date/equal-available-horizon Brier on identical cases, then refit selected specification before holdout.
weighting: Equal outcome-date influence, distributed equally over its available horizons; training case frequency weights are 2 divided by distinct eligible horizons times date multiplicity. Complete two-horizon P0 retains v1 sample-SD convention.
